method: Actual in-app browser; menu, gifts, proposals, saves and hotkeys operated through the UI. Test games used the separate qa=1 save store.

checks.revealedMap: Selected mode 2 in the start menu; terrain and entire minimap visibly revealed without fog. Diplomacy reports the active saved mode 2.
checks.exploredMap: Selected mode 1 for a new seed-7 skirmish with three AI players; whole terrain/minimap known, current sight remains lit and remote terrain dimmed. No remote enemy markers exposed; diplomacy reports mode 1.
checks.gift: Sent 200 food to AI player 2; own food changed from 800 to 600 and the event log recorded the gift.
checks.peace: Sent peace proposal; pending state shown, then AI accepted and relation changed from Hostile to Neutral.
checks.alliance: Sent an alliance proposal with the default Full sight checkbox checked. AI accepted, relation became Allied, mutual sight was reported; other two AI players remained hostile and no victory occurred.
checks.sightNegotiation: Requested sight separation: Full remained active while pending, then changed to None after acceptance. A later Full proposal was accepted and restored mutual sight.
checks.saveLoad: Saved, reloaded the page and resumed. Food 600, alliance, mutual sight, event log and active Revealed mode persisted even when the new-game selector was set to Explored.
checks.controls: F4 reopened diplomacy. A paused game displayed its pause notice; Spiel fortsetzen resumed it inside the dialog. New skirmish reset relationships and the event log.
checks.visual: Final v5 dialog is opaque and readable, with no tiled frame borders; hidden proposal and vision controls remain absent when irrelevant. Diplomacy and map mode controls fit the 1280x720 view.
checks.console: No warning/error entries returned after final v5 gameplay checks.

limits: Focused UI/function checks. Full original treaty terms, rendered FPS, physical multi-machine WebRTC/NAT and a full original-game comparison were not tested here.
